## Download

- **Windows:** `cdda-companion-{{VERSION}}-windows-x64.zip`
- **Linux:** `cdda-companion-{{VERSION}}-linux-x64.tar.gz` (glibc 2.35 or newer)

## Install

1. Unpack it and put `cdda-companion` (`cdda-companion.exe` on Windows) in your Cataclysm: DDA game folder,
   the one with `data/` and `gfx/` inside.
2. Start it. Your browser opens on your map.

It finds the game and the world you played last by itself. If it can't, the page asks.
It never writes to your save, except when you load one of its save slots.

Made for **Cataclysm: DDA 0.I**.

## What's new

- The page now looks like one of the game's own windows: the game's 16 colours, one monospace font,
  plain single-line borders.
- It uses your colour theme. Pick one in the game's colour manager and the companion follows it, map included.
- Long world names and save dates no longer break in the middle.
- Shorter, plainer wording on the setup screen and in dialogs.
